evidence.researchFinding: Jacoby Brissett is the projected bridge starter under new head coach Mike LaFleur; rookie Carson Beck and James Conner are questionable and Trey Benson is on IR. The uncertainty is monitored without a carried move.

Michael Penix Jr. is fully cleared, but Kevin Stefanski has kept the Week 1 QB competition with Tua Tagovailoa open. James Pearce Jr. is suspended into midseason and Jalon Walker is on IR with an ACL injury. The defensive-front losses justify a modest carried downgrade; QB uncertainty is kept matchup-specific.

Lamar Jackson remains QB1. Zay Flowers and Nnamdi Madubuike are questionable and Danny Pinter is on IR. Jesse Minter is the new head coach; current uncertainty is monitored but not yet large enough for a carried move.

Josh Allen remains QB1. Connor McGovern, Jude Bowry, Mike Hoecht, Keon Coleman and Khalil Shakir are among Week 1 questionables, with Phidarian Mathis suspended. No single confirmed loss warrants moving the carried rating yet.

Bryce Young remains QB1. LT Ikem Ekwonu is expected back for Week 1, while Derrick Brown/Chuba Hubbard and multiple defenders are questionable; Nic Scourton remains on IR. No new confirmed loss clears the carried threshold.

Caleb Williams remains QB1. Jaylon Johnson and a broad defensive group are questionable, and the roster is changing with Gervon Dexter reportedly traded to Atlanta. The current cluster is kept under review without a carried move until the cutdown/trade picture settles.
Joe Burrow remains QB1. Ja'Marr Chase, Myles Murphy, Shemar Stewart and Daxton Hill are among Week 1 questionables. No confirmed durable absence warrants a carried move yet.

Deshaun Watson has been named Week 1 starter under new head coach Todd Monken after missing all of 2025 and not taking a real snap since 2024. Alex Wright is on IR and OL/defensive depth injuries remain. The long QB layoff is handled as a matchup adjustment, not a carried team downgrade.

Dak Prescott remains QB1. OT Tyler Guyton and LB Marist Liufau are questionable, while Dallas added OT Broderick Jones in a cutdown-period trade. The personnel reshuffle is monitored without a carried move.

Bo Nix remains QB1. Jonathon Cooper is unavailable for Week 1 and Marvin Mims/Luke Wattenberg are questionable. Cooper's absence is handled as a Week 1 matchup adjustment rather than a permanent team-rating move.

Jared Goff remains QB1. Center Cade Mays is out for Week 1, Seth McLaughlin is questionable, and Brian Branch/Kerby Joseph are working toward Week 1 returns. The mixed status is handled as matchup uncertainty rather than a carried move.

Jordan Love remains QB1. Josh Jacobs is on a roster exemption with an expected Week 4 return; Micah Parsons remains on PUP and Tucker Kraft is questionable. Jacobs' newly confirmed early-season absence warrants a modest additional carried downgrade, while older preseason injuries are not double-counted.

C.J. Stroud remains QB1. RT Braden Smith is questionable after a foot issue, with Jadeveon Clowney and multiple defensive/skill players also questionable. No confirmed durable loss clears the carried-rating threshold yet.

Daniel Jones remains the projected QB1. Alec Pierce, Josh Downs, Tyler Warren and multiple defensive backs are questionable; the Colts also acquired C Sedrick Van Pran-Granger. The cluster remains matchup-specific until Week 1 practice reports clarify availability.

Trevor Lawrence remains QB1. Brian Thomas Jr., Jakobi Meyers, Wyatt Milum and Patrick Mekari are questionable; Jacksonville also acquired QB Quinn Ewers as depth. No current durable change warrants moving the rating.

Patrick Mahomes has taken first-team work and is on track for Week 1 pending final medical/coach approval. Trey Smith and several defenders are questionable. No carried rating change is made; Mahomes clearance remains a game-specific checkpoint.

Justin Herbert remains QB1. C Tyler Biadasz is on IR, OT Branson Taylor is on IR until an expected Week 5 return, and Rashawn Slater is questionable. The concentrated offensive-line losses justify a modest carried downgrade.

Matthew Stafford remains the projected QB1. Puka Nacua, Myles Garrett, Alaric Jackson and Kobie Turner are among Week 1 questionables. Nate Scheelhaase is the new OC. The opener is the neutral-site Melbourne game, so no Los Angeles home-field credit is applied.

Kirk Cousins was formally named the Week 1 starting quarterback after the prior board carried a +0.5 QB_UNCERTAINTY game factor. This is a material information resolution, but removing or recalibrating a quarterback numeric term requires APPROVED_WALTERS_QB_PERFORMANCE authority, which was not located in the current governed repository package. The existing fair is preserved rather than manually changed.

Malik Willis is the projected starter after the Tua departure; Quinn Ewers was traded to Jacksonville. Trey Moore is out through an expected Week 5 return and Zach Sieler is questionable. No carried move is made pending final roster/practice clarification.

Kyler Murray has been named the starter over J.J. McCarthy. McCarthy remains questionable but is QB2. The starter decision resolves a major uncertainty; no additional carried move is made because the current seed is treated as already reflecting Minnesota's offseason QB transition.
Drake Maye remains QB1. Harold Landry is expected back for Week 1 but Marcus Bryant is questionable. No durable current loss warrants a carried change.

Tyler Shough remains the projected QB1. DT Bryan Bresee and OT Dillon Radunz are on IR with ACL injuries; Alvin Kamara and Cameron Jordan are questionable and Jordyn Tyson is doubtful. The confirmed trench losses justify a modest carried downgrade.

Jaxson Dart remains the projected QB1 under new head coach John Harbaugh. Malik Nabers, Tyrone Tracy and multiple OL/DB starters are questionable. The cluster is significant but not yet confirmed enough for a carried move.
Geno Smith remains the projected QB1. Breece Hall and several edge/secondary players are questionable. No confirmed durable loss warrants a carried move.

Jalen Hurts remains QB1. Cooper DeJean and several secondary/OL depth pieces are questionable; Jonathan Greenard is on PUP with a Week 1 return expectation. No carried move is made pending practice clarification.

Aaron Rodgers remains the projected QB1 under new head coach Mike McCarthy. DK Metcalf, Jalen Ramsey, Joey Porter Jr. and Michael Pittman are among questionables. No carried move pending practice clarification.

Sam Darnold remains the projected QB1 for the defending champions. Nick Emmanwori is questionable and depth injuries remain, but no current item clears the threshold for a carried rating move. Week 1 is a true Seattle home opener against New England.

Brock Purdy remains QB1. George Kittle has returned to work but is still listed questionable, while Nick Bosa, Christian McCaffrey, Dominick Puni and multiple defensive backs are also questionable. The Rams game is in Melbourne, so venue is treated as neutral and the injury cluster stays in matchup uncertainty rather than a carried downgrade.
Baker Mayfield remains QB1. Emeka Egbuka, Jalen McMillan, Rueben Bain Jr. and several defenders are questionable. No confirmed durable loss warrants a carried move.

Cam Ward is the established starter under new head coach Robert Saleh; Will Levis was waived and Mitchell Trubisky is the backup. Current injuries include defensive depth and a questionable backup QB, but no carried change is made.

Jayden Daniels remains QB1. LT Laremy Tunsil is out well beyond Week 1, DT Johnny Newton is out into midseason and Dorance Armstrong is suspended through Week 1; Washington added veteran OT D.J. Humphries. The confirmed trench/edge losses justify a carried downgrade despite the depth signing.
